To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

emergent languages can transfer to downstream natural language tasks via corpus transfer and the performance on downstream tasks correlates highly with the performance of a translation-based metric that predicts the transferability of emergent languages.

1) corpus transfer from synthetic emergent languages to natural languages can improve the performance of language modeling and image-captioning tasks; and 2) the translation-based metric is a more reliable predictor of the transferability of emergent languages compared to topographic similarity.

(i) corpus transfer from emergent languages to natural languages is a novel and promising approach to improve language processing; (ii) emergent languages are transferable to natural language tasks, and (iii) the transferability can be predicted via translation-based metrics.
